findings.text: Most users in this group use a mid-range or low-cost Android phone, and many share it with family.
Near vision declines after about 45, so small text and low-contrast grey text are hard to read.
The most common complaint is not finding the reorder button and losing the cart after a call interrupts.
WhatsApp and a UPI payments app are the apps they open most; both use a bottom bar and big list rows.
Ordering happens at home, now and then, often with a family member helping.
Many read the app in Hindi or another Indian language rather than English.
Money and health are both at stake: a wrong medicine or a double charge is the fear named most.
The top medicine-ordering apps all lead with search and offers; none puts last month's order first.
